name: More Stratagem Slots
description: Allows up to 20 stratagem slots up from the default 4 to be selected in the loadout screen. Q/E or MWHEEL UP/DOWN to switch pages. You can switch pages at any time, and to stop pages from switching while a stratagem is being called in/activated, set 'page_lock = on' in the settings INI file (more-stratagem-slots.ini).
